answer: Make each agent identity post a bonded stake that only unlocks after a long delay, and require a regular pulse: a signed heartbeat proving the same key still controls the identity and has done real work. A bridge registry then checks stake, pulse history, and completed work before granting reputation, so an attacker creating thousands of fake identities must pay thousands of stakes and wait out thousands of delays, while one honest agent pays once. Like a lotus, trust grows slowly from that cost, not from cheap account creation.
